optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Process Data Analyst, Steel Rolling Mill

professionalSummary.text: Process data analyst with three years of experience at a steel rolling mill, building and maintaining process monitoring dashboards from sensor and quality laboratory data for two rolling lines.
professionalSummary.witness: Process data analyst at a steel rolling mill for three years, building and maintaining the process monitoring dashboards from the mill's sensor and quality laboratory data for the two rolling lines.

professionalSummary.text: Investigated out-of-specification events with mill engineers under the investigation procedure, with 31 investigations documented in the register and findings accepted by engineers.
professionalSummary.witness: Investigated the out-of-specification events with the mill engineers under the investigation procedure; the investigation register records thirty-one investigations with my findings accepted by the mill engineers and the corrective actions they took.

professionalSummary.text: Prepared weekly process reviews for the mill manager, filed in the process data folder.
professionalSummary.witness: Prepared the weekly process review for the mill manager, with the reviews filed in the process data folder.

professionalSummary.text: Supported process change trials with trial analyses, recording responsibility boundaries with mill manager approvals documented on trial records.
professionalSummary.witness: Supported the process change trials with the trial analyses; the change approvals were the mill manager's, recorded on each trial record together with which analyses were mine and which the automation team's.

professionalSummary.text: Documented limitations and hand-over conditions for each investigation and trial analysis.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each investigation and each trial analysis.

experienceHighlights.text: Built and maintained process monitoring dashboards for two rolling lines using sensor and quality data.
experienceHighlights.witness: Process data analyst at a steel rolling mill for three years, building and maintaining the process monitoring dashboards from the mill's sensor and quality laboratory data for the two rolling lines.

experienceHighlights.text: Conducted 31 investigations of out-of-specification events with mill engineers, resulting in accepted findings and implemented corrective actions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Investigated the out-of-specification events with the mill engineers under the investigation procedure; the investigation register records thirty-one investigations with my findings accepted by the mill engineers and the corrective actions they took.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared and filed weekly process reviews for the mill manager in the process data folder.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the weekly process review for the mill manager, with the reviews filed in the process data folder.

experienceHighlights.text: Supported process change trials with documented responsibility boundaries and mill manager approvals.
experienceHighlights.witness: Supported the process change trials with the trial analyses; the change approvals were the mill manager's, recorded on each trial record together with which analyses were mine and which the automation team's.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented limitations and hand-over conditions for all investigations and trials.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each investigation and each trial analysis.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Dashboard specification, investigation register extract, weekly process review, and trial record with approval, all filed in the process data folder as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one dashboard specification, the investigation register extract for one quarter with the accepted findings, one weekly process review and one trial record with its approval, with the process data folder references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Process monitoring dashboard development and maintenance using sensor and quality data.
skills.witness: Process data analyst at a steel rolling mill for three years, building and maintaining the process monitoring dashboards from the mill's sensor and quality laboratory data for the two rolling lines.

skills.text: Investigation of out-of-specification events with mill engineers and documentation of findings.
skills.witness: Investigated the out-of-specification events with the mill engineers under the investigation procedure; the investigation register records thirty-one investigations with my findings accepted by the mill engineers and the corrective actions they took.

skills.text: Preparation of weekly process reviews for mill managers.
skills.witness: Prepared the weekly process review for the mill manager, with the reviews filed in the process data folder.

skills.text: Supporting process change trials with documentation of responsibility boundaries and approvals.
skills.witness: Supported the process change trials with the trial analyses; the change approvals were the mill manager's, recorded on each trial record together with which analyses were mine and which the automation team's.

skills.text: Documentation of analysis limitations and hand-over conditions.
skills.witness: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each investigation and each trial analysis.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish all five requirements through the candidate's experience and work samples, but do not establish how the candidate explains findings to skeptical mill engineers or whether they won over the engineers (as noted in the interview note).
